description: A fast native mail client with instant startup and a small memory footprint
notes: This is an early alpha build: back up anything you keep in it before upgrading.

The vendor's portable ZIP is used as-is. Flectar Mail stores its mailboxes and settings in '%APPDATA%\flectar-mail', not in the install directory, so your mail survives 'scoop update' and 'scoop uninstall'.

There is no self-updater and no run-at-login hook in this build, so nothing is registered with Windows startup and nothing will replace the Scoop-managed files. Update with 'scoop update flectar-mail'.
